picks.headline: Anthropic Releases Claude Sonnet 5.5 with Lower Costs and Faster Speed
picks.why: The updated model runs over 30% faster at up to 30% lower cost while replacing older models on Claude's free tier.
picks.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5

picks.headline: xAI's Grok 4.7 Launches on Bedrock with 500K Context Window
picks.why: Provides enterprise AWS users access to xAI's flagship model with four configurable reasoning effort levels.
picks.title: Grok 4.7 is now available on Amazon Bedrock

picks.headline: OpenAI Demonstrates GPT-6 Astra Performance on Enterprise Tax Workbooks
picks.why: Highlights double the processing speed over GPT-5.6 Sol on complex 50-tab financial tasks.
picks.title: Basis completes a tax workbook 2x faster with GPT-6 Astra

picks.headline: OpenAI Releases Initial Guidelines for Frontier Model Safety Cases
picks.why: Establishes formal methodologies for constructing safety cases during frontier AI model training.
picks.title: Towards safety cases for frontier AI training

picks.headline: Self-Propagating AI Viruses Hop Across LLM Agents via Shared Artifacts
picks.why: Demonstrates that persistent agent memory and shared workspaces can transmit malware across independent agent deployments.
picks.title: Share-Borne AI Virus: Memory-Hopping Attacks Across LLM Agents

picks.headline: Post-Training Reinforcement Learning Easily Overcomes Distillation Defenses
picks.why: Shows that standard SFT safety evaluations miss model vulnerabilities that emerge once subsequent reinforcement learning breaks IP protection.
picks.title: Distillation Defenses Easily Break After Reinforcement Learning

picks.headline: MCP Servers and Plugins Become Primary AI Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
picks.why: Malicious updates in ecosystem components like postmark-mcp demonstrate that security boundaries must extend beyond base models.
picks.title: From Models to MCP Servers, Skills, and Plugins: Rethinking Trust in the AI Supply Chain

picks.headline: AWS Launches vLLM-Omni Deep Learning Container on SageMaker AI
picks.why: Enables low-latency real-time streaming audio and multimodal generation over bidirectional WebSocket connections.
picks.title: Build real-time voice applications with vLLM-Omni on SageMaker AI – Part 1

papers.headline: Scaling Laws Map Path to Encoder-Free Multimodal Model Parity
papers.why: Demonstrates that dedicated vision encoders can be eliminated in multimodal pretraining, predicting loss parity at 10^22 FLOPs.
papers.title: How Far Are We from Removing the Visual Encoder? Scaling Laws for Encoder-Free Multimodal Pretraining

papers.headline: Telescopic LMs Function as Valid LMs at Any Truncated Depth
papers.why: Uses stochastic prefix supervision during pretraining to produce a single Transformer capable of serving inference at variable depth layers.
papers.title: Telescopic Language Models

papers.headline: Latent Reasoning Learns Recurrent Search for Depth Generalization
papers.why: Reveals that implicit continuous latent reasoning discovers internal search algorithms that generalize to longer hop distances better than Chain-of-Thought.
papers.title: Not All Thinking is Created Equal: Latent Reasoning Discovers a Recurrent Search Algorithm for Depth Generalization
